_comment: Skeleton only — no real attestations. Manual attestations cover controls that cannot be evidenced by automated findings alone (e.g. physical security, board-level policy sign-off, third-party audit results). Each entry must be traceable to who attested and when, and must expire — an attestation with no expiry is a liability, not evidence.
